mapper.select: SELECT * FROM shop_orders WHERE customer_id=#{customerId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC
SELECT * FROM shop_orders WHERE id=#{orderId} AND customer_id=#{customerId}
SELECT DISTINCT o.* FROM shop_orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.id WHERE i.merchant_id=#{merchantId} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
SELECT o.* FROM shop_orders o WHERE o.id=#{orderId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items i WHERE i.order_id=o.id AND i.merchant_id=#{merchantId})
mapper.sql: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items own WHERE own.order_id = o.id AND own.merchant_id = #{merchantId})

choose.otherwise: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items own WHERE own.order_id = o.id AND own.merchant_id = #{request.merchantId})

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status = 'PAID' THEN 1 END) AS pendingConfirm, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status = 'CONFIRMED' THEN 1 END) AS pendingShip FROM shop_orders o WHERE o.status IN ('PAID', 'CONFIRMED') AND
SELECT * FROM order_items WHERE order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id,actor_id,event_type,from_status,to_status,detail,trigger_source,scheduled_task_id,created_at FROM order_events WHERE order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY created_at,id
SELECT status FROM shop_orders WHERE id=#{orderId}
SELECT customer_id FROM shop_orders WHERE id=#{orderId}
SELECT i.id AS order_item_id,i.product_id FROM order_items i JOIN shop_orders o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE i.id=#{itemId} AND o.customer_id=#{customerId} AND o.status IN ('RECEIVED','COMPLETED')
SELECT payload_fingerprint,response_payload FROM order_remote_message_inbox WHERE message_id=#{mutationId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_remote_message_inbox(message_id,message_kind,payload_fingerprint,processing_status) VALUES (#{mutationId},'MUTATION',#{fingerprint},'RECEIVED') ON CONFLICT (message_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE order_remote_message_inbox SET processing_status='APPLIED',response_payload=#{response}, processed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE message_id=#{mutationId}
UPDATE shop_orders SET logistics_delivered_at=COALESCE(logistics_delivered_at,#{occurredAt}), updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND status IN ('SHIPPED','RECEIVED','COMPLETED')
UPDATE shop_orders SET status=#{toStatus},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND status=#{fromStatus} AND (#{toStatus}<>'REFUNDING' OR shipment_intent_key IS NULL)
UPDATE shop_orders SET inventory_status=#{toStatus},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND inventory_status=#{fromStatus}
UPDATE shop_orders SET inventory_status='WAITING_COMMIT',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND inventory_status='RESERVED'
UPDATE shop_orders SET status='CANCELLING',cancel_reason=#{reason},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND status='PENDING_PAYMENT'
UPDATE shop_orders SET status='CANCELLED',cancelled_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND status='CANCELLING'
UPDATE shop_orders SET status='PAID',cancel_reason=NULL,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND status='CANCELLING'
UPDATE shop_orders SET status='PAID',cancelled_at=NULL, cancel_reason='Recovered after late successful payment',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND status='CANCELLED'
UPDATE shop_orders SET status='RECEIVED',received_at=#{occurredAt},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND status='SHIPPED'
UPDATE shop_orders SET status='COMPLETED',completed_at=#{occurredAt},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND status='RECEIVED'

UPDATE shop_orders SET status='CONFIRMED',confirmed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND status='PAID' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items WHERE order_id=shop_orders.id AND merchant_id=#{actorId})
UPDATE shop_orders SET shipment_intent_key=NULL,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND status='CONFIRMED' AND shipment_intent_key=#{key}

UPDATE shop_orders SET shipment_intent_key=#{key},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{mutation.orderId} AND status='CONFIRMED' AND inventory_status='COMMITTED' AND (shipment_intent_key IS NULL OR (NOT #{unreservedOnly} AND shipment_intent_key=#{key})) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM order_package_allocations p WHERE p.order_id=shop_orders.id AND p.voided_at IS NULL ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM order_warehouse_amounts w WHERE w.order_id=shop_orders.id AND w.warehouse_id<>1 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM order_line_refund_admissions a WHERE a.order_id=shop_orders.id AND a.status='HELD' ) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items WHERE order_id=shop_orders.id AND merchant_id=#{mutation.actorId})

UPDATE shop_orders SET status='SHIPPED',carrier=#{mutation.carrier},tracking_number=#{mutation.trackingNumber}, shipped_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),shipment_intent_key=NULL WHERE id=#{mutation.orderId} AND status='CONFIRMED' AND inventory_status='COMMITTED' AND shipment_intent_key=#{key} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items WHERE order_id=shop_orders.id AND merchant_id=#{mutation.actorId})
mapper.select: SELECT status FROM shop_orders WHERE id=#{orderId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE shop_orders SET status='REFUNDING',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND status=#{previous} AND shipment_intent_key IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM order_package_allocations p WHERE p.order_id=shop_orders.id AND p.voided_at IS NULL ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM order_line_refund_admissions a WHERE a.order_id=shop_orders.id AND a.status='HELD' )

UPDATE shop_orders SET carrier=#{carrier},tracking_number=#{trackingNumber}, shipment_version=shipment_version+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=#{orderId} AND status='SHIPPED' AND shipment_version=#{expectedShipmentVersion} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items WHERE order_id=shop_orders.id AND merchant_id=#{actorId})
